description: Gold-standard baseline for Python API services (FastAPI primary, Flask for tiny sidecars) running in Docker. This baseline has no audit_checklist: app-audit derives checks from `requirements`, `anti_patterns` and `deployment_checklist`. Use it as the whole grade for a standalone Python service, or as a SECTION of the parent app's audit when the service is a sidecar of a Next.js app.

baseline_versions._note: Placeholders — set to your verified floors (OSV ranges / vendor releases) before the first run.
baseline_versions.starlette: >=<floor from the latest starlette advisory> — pin explicitly; FastAPI's own range may allow a vulnerable starlette

framework.uvicorn: Pinned, [standard] extras (handles SIGTERM; no dumb-init needed unless zombie children are observed)

database.migrations: Alembic (create_all only as a dev fallback)
database.postgresql: Digest-pinned postgres alpine image, one instance per app

validation.config: Settings class with env_file support and an @lru_cache singleton — validates all env at import time

security.cors: CORSMiddleware with explicit allow_origins, allow_methods, allow_headers (never '*', never '*' with allow_credentials)
security.auth: API key via APIKeyHeader('X-API-Key') + hmac.compare_digest(); applied as Depends() at include_router level
security.security_headers: SecurityHeadersMiddleware adds X-Frame-Options DENY, X-Content-Type-Options nosniff, Referrer-Policy strict-origin-when-cross-origin, Permissions-Policy
security.encryption: cryptography (Fernet / AES-GCM) for at-rest secrets; validate the key in lifespan(), fail fast

fastapi_app: app/main.py (FastAPI entry, lifespan, middleware, router includes)
app/config.py (Pydantic Settings + @lru_cache) — small apps may inline os.getenv with explicit None checks
tests/ (conftest.py with TestClient + override_get_db + SQLite in-memory)
.dockerignore (at this build context, not only the repo root)

api: CORSMiddleware with an explicit origin list — never '*'
slowapi rate limiting wired (limiter + exception handler)
API key validation via Depends(require_api_key) applied at include_router level
Missing configured key -> 503 (fail closed), missing header -> 401, wrong key -> 403
Model/LLM output parsed through a Pydantic model, never json.loads + .get()
docker: Non-root user (uid 1000 or 1001 — pick one, document it)
cap_drop: ALL, no cap_add for pure-Python services
read_only: true + tmpfs for /tmp and cache dirs
Health check via Python urllib (no curl in slim images), 127.0.0.1 not localhost
supply_chain: Every requirement pinned with == and installed from a hash-locked file (--require-hashes)
Transitive security floors pinned explicitly when the parent's range allows a vulnerable version (e.g. starlette under fastapi)
Sweep EVERY pin against OSV each audit — never a hand-picked subset

testing.fixtures: conftest.py with a test DB (SQLite in-memory) and dependency overrides for get_db + require_api_key

dockerfile.base: Patch- and digest-pinned python slim, multi-stage
dockerfile.system_deps: Build tools (gcc, libpq-dev) in builder only; runtime gets only the runtime libs
dockerfile.venv: Build into /opt/venv in stage 1, COPY --from=builder — keeps compilers out of the final image
dockerfile.entrypoint: CMD ["uvicorn", "app.main:app", "--host", "0.0.0.0", "--port", "<port>"] — 0.0.0.0 INSIDE the container is fine; only compose `ports:` publishes to the host

observability.logging: logging.getLogger(__name__); JSON output preferred (structlog or a JSON formatter)
observability.health: GET /health unauthenticated; round-trips the DB where there is one
observability.startup: @asynccontextmanager lifespan — fail fast on missing config; production runs `alembic upgrade head` before start
observability.request_id: Starlette middleware reading/generating X-Request-Id into contextvars

anti_patterns.name: Sync HTTP calls in async handlers
anti_patterns.fix: httpx.AsyncClient — never requests.post inside an async route

anti_patterns.name: Auth per route instead of per router
Subprocess via shell string
anti_patterns.fix: subprocess.run([...]) with list args; never shell=True with interpolated input

anti_patterns.name: Dead requirements file
anti_patterns.fix: Check which file the Dockerfile actually COPYs from the compose build context; delete or fix the other

good.name: Settings singleton
Router-level auth + slowapi
good.code:
limiter = Limiter(key_func=get_remote_address)
app.state.limiter = limiter
app.add_exception_handler(RateLimitExceeded, _rate_limit_exceeded_handler)
api_key_dep = [Depends(require_api_key)]
app.include_router(documents.router, prefix='/api/documents', dependencies=api_key_dep)

good.name: Timing-safe API key

bad.name: Blocking call in async route
bad.code: resp = requests.post(URL, json=payload)  # blocks the event loop

bad.name: No session cleanup
bad.code:
db = SessionLocal()
return db.query(Model).all()  # session never closed

deployment_checklist: Multi-stage Dockerfile; compilers only in builder; /opt/venv copied across
API key compared with hmac.compare_digest; fail closed when unset
pool_pre_ping=True; alembic upgrade head before start
Log rotation in compose (json-file, max-size, max-file)
